{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOUDROfM8AAAABa2JLHg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlR_zzhEb5mE", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlR_z", "number": 142, "title": "Add DOMCombiner for live ASR previews alongside translated history and bottom-aware Live scrolling", "body": "## Problem

After #140, `PairedTextToDOM` correctly formats only one completed translation pair and `DOMAccumulator` explicitly retains comparison history. We now want to show live ASR provisional text **below** that committed history in the **same** `LiveTextDisplay`, without adding preview/history semantics to formatters, the accumulator, or the display.

The Live display's DOM snapshots currently replace their content without a deliberate scroll-follow policy. When new pairs arrive, users should follow the bottom only if they were already reading the bottom; otherwise the UI must not pull them away from older content.

## Expected outcome

### 1. Add one generic DOMCombiner processor

Introduce `DOMCombiner`, with two independent DOM snapshot inputs and one DOM output:

| Port | Contract | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `first` | DOM input | Latest first snapshot |
| `second` | DOM input | Latest second snapshot |
| `dom` | DOM output | First followed by second |

- Retain only the **latest snapshot per input**, not a history. Whenever either input changes, emit a **complete** combined snapshot in fixed `first → second` order. No producer-aware behavior, source IDs, translation awareness, or extra modes.
- An empty DOM snapshot replaces/clears that input's previous content. The other input stays intact and renders normally. Handle initial empty inputs, repeated updates, and new sessions predictably.
- Use the existing safe inert-DOM validation/deep-clone ownership contract so fragments and CSS remain safe for fan-out; do not move native DOM through Workers.
- Register the processor in the existing graph schema, Graph Editor palette, runtime, docs and tests. Do not add a new output Node or change `LiveTextDisplay.dom`.

### 2. Compose committed translation history with provisional English ASR

The intended graph is:

```text
MicrophoneAudio.audio → SpeechToTextZipformerEn.audio
                               │
          provisional ─────────┤
               ↓               └─ final → OpusMtEnJa.text
           TextToDOM                           │
               │                         source/text/error
               │                               ↓
               │                        PairedTextToDOM
               │                               ↓
               │                        DOMAccumulator.append
               │                               │ dom
               ↓                               ↓
     DOMCombiner.second                DOMCombiner.first
                       \             /
                        DOMCombiner.dom
                              ↓
                       LiveTextDisplay.dom
```

- `first` contains accumulated, completed English/Japanese pairs; `second` contains **only the latest** provisional English transcription, rendered literally via existing `TextToDOM`.
- When the ASR emits a final result, **clear its corresponding provisional output** (emit empty provisional TEXT in the correct event order) so the prior preview disappears even while translation is still running. New provisional speech can arrive later and must not be cleared by an older, delayed translation result.
- Keep final ASR output and translation scheduling contracts intact. `PairedTextToDOM` still formats only completed correlated pairs, and `DOMAccumulator` remains append-only. Never append a provisional result to committed history or turn previews into translated pairs.
- Do not add pending-translation row tracking, speculative translation, another output type, a new generic state framework, or special ASR/translation rules inside `DOMCombiner`. While final English is awaiting its translation, it need not remain on display as a separate pending row; document this intentional scope limit.
- For ASRs that already expose `provisional/final`, preserve existing downstream preview/final behavior (including `TextAccumulator`) when clearing the provisional channel at finalization. Do not emit extra committed finals or erase newer preview text.

### 3. Implement bottom-aware scrolling in the shared Live renderer

The scroll policy belongs to the existing `LiveTextDisplay` region, **not** a processor:

- Before replacing a DOM snapshot, determine whether that region's scroll container was at/near the bottom (small tolerance for rounding, e.g. 24 px).
- If at the bottom, follow the newly rendered bottom as the committed history grows or the provisional tail changes.
- If the user scrolled up, keep their reading position instead of jumping to the bottom on incoming updates. When the user manually scrolls back to the bottom, following resumes automatically.
- Apply to every DOM-based Live display without introducing new settings or output ports. Preserve independent scroll state across multiple displays.
- Account for current `replaceChildren` snapshots, layout changes, empty/shorter previews, content growth, and browser scroll anchoring; avoid forced focus/selection changes or smooth-scrolling animation on each update.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] `DOMCombiner` accepts typed DOM inputs `first`/`second` and emits their latest combined snapshot in order; replacement and clearing do not accumulate old content. Invalid typed wiring is rejected.
- [ ] It is addable, savable/reloadable, and executable in the existing Graph Editor/runtime. Tests cover inputs arriving in either order, repeated updates, empty fragments, Start/Stop/Cancel, safe clones and fan-out.
- [ ] The full ASR → translation → paired DOM → DOMAccumulator path plus ASR provisional → TextToDOM path renders **one** Live region with committed bilingual pairs above the live provisional English tail.
- [ ] On ASR final, the corresponding provisional tail clears; no stale preview survives while translation is delayed. A subsequent provisional utterance is not cleared by completion of an older translation. Repeated final phrases appear once each as committed pairs; failures and Cancel do not revive stale content.
- [ ] A Live region near the bottom follows new pairs and changing previews; a user scrolled up stays at the same reading position; manually scrolling back to the bottom resumes following. Different Live regions behave independently. Browser-level tests verify this with actual overflowing content.
- [ ] Existing plain transcript, standalone paired display, explicit DOM history, other ASR paths, focused-field/TTS routing and saved graphs remain valid; no unnecessary migration or extra UI controls.
- [ ] Run applicable unit, Chromium/WebKit and packaged-extension tests and report any asset-dependent build/real-inference limitations honestly.

## Required post-merge verification

None. Test the functionality in local browser/packaged-extension fixtures before merge.

## Context

- #138 / PR #139: DOM-only Live output, TextToDOM and PairedTextToDOM.
- #140 / PR #141: paired formatter has no implicit history; DOMAccumulator accumulates explicitly.
- `web/dom-nodes.js`: DOM formatting, accumulator, and safe clone validation.
- `web/transcription-nodes.js` / `web/zipformer-node.js`: independent provisional/final ASR output.
- `extension/live-text-regions.js`, `extension/recorder.css`: DOM mounting and independent scrolling regions.
- `extension/graph.js`, `extension/graph-runtime.js`: typed graph catalog/runtime.

**Design boundary:** formatters format; DOMAccumulator retains committed history; DOMCombiner combines the latest two DOM snapshots; LiveTextDisplay mounts the result and manages its own scroll position.", "url": "https://github.com/takahirox/my-audio-to-text/issues/142", "created_at": "2026-10-29T09:15:11Z", "state": "OPEN", "repository": "takahirox/my-audio-to-text", "labels": ["task"], "priority": null, "status": "In Progress", "is_archived": false}, "context": {}, "resources": {}, "allocation": {}, "instruction": null, "run_id": "fc42f0a75c1b4e95a5acdf7ee279767f"}
